```plato
    // On the axis, three quarters of the way from the Apex to the base — i.e. one
    // quarter of the height above the base, the standard solid-cone result.
    Centroid(c: Cone): Point3D
        => c.Apex + c.Axis.Vector * (0.75 * c.Height);
```

## Line 492

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/spatial-primitives.library.plato, line 492](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/spatial-primitives.library.plato#L492).

```plato

    // On the axis, at (h/4) * (r1^2 + 2*r1*r2 + 3*r2^2) / (r1^2 + r1*r2 + r2^2)
    // above the BOTTOM disk — restated here relative to Center, which sits at h/2.
    // Checks out at both ends: r2 = 0 gives h/4 (the cone) and r1 = r2 gives h/2
    // (the cylinder). https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frustum
    Centroid(f: ConicalFrustum): Point3D
    {
        var r1 = f.BottomRadius;
        var r2 = f.TopRadius;
        var fromBottom = f.Height * 0.25
            * (r1.Square + 2.0 * r1 * r2 + 3.0 * r2.Square)
            / (r1.Square + r1 * r2 + r2.Square);
        return f.BottomCenter + f.Axis.Vector * fromBottom;
    }
```

```plato
    // The arithmetic mean of the three vertices, which for a triangle is also its
    // area centroid.
    Centroid(t: Triangle3D): Point3D
        => ((t.A.X + t.B.X + t.C.X) / 3.0,
            (t.A.Y + t.B.Y + t.C.Y) / 3.0,
            (t.A.Z + t.B.Z + t.C.Z) / 3.0);
```

## Line 654

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/spatial-primitives.library.plato, line 654](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/spatial-primitives.library.plato#L654).

```plato

    // The area-weighted mean of the two triangles' centroids, which is the exact
    // area centroid for a planar quad.
    Centroid(q: Quad3D): Point3D
    {
        var first = Triangle3D(q.A, q.B, q.C);
        var second = Triangle3D(q.A, q.C, q.D);
        var total = first.Area + second.Area;
        return first.Centroid.Lerp(second.Centroid, second.Area / total);
    }
```

```plato
    // The arithmetic mean of the four vertices, which for a simplex is also its
    // volume centroid.
    Centroid(t: Tetrahedron): Point3D
        => ((t.A.X + t.B.X + t.C.X + t.D.X) * 0.25,
            (t.A.Y + t.B.Y + t.C.Y + t.D.Y) * 0.25,
            (t.A.Z + t.B.Z + t.C.Z + t.D.Z) * 0.25);
```

## Line 879

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/spatial-primitives.library.plato, line 879](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/spatial-primitives.library.plato#L879).

```plato

    // On the axis, at 3*(2R - h)^2 / (4*(3R - h)) from the SPHERE's centre. Checks
    // out at both ends: h = R gives 3R/8 (the hemisphere) and h = 2R gives 0 (the
    // whole ball). https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spherical_cap
    Centroid(c: SphericalCap): Point3D
    {
        var h = c.CapHeight;
        var r = c.Sphere.Radius;
        var distance = 3.0 * (2.0 * r - h).Square / (4.0 * (3.0 * r - h));
        return c.Sphere.Center + c.Axis.Vector * distance;
    }
```
